newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor expects H2 earnings similar to H1.
newsitem.headline: Gencor expects H2 earnings similar to H1.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Tuesday it expected results for the second half of the year to be similiar to those in the six months to end-December 1996.
"If nothing goes wrong, I believe we would at least get similiar results in the second six months," Gencor chairman Brain Gilbertson told Reuters.
Gilbertson said in looking forward to the second half, an important factor would be the performance of the rand and the price of aluminium.

"You have to be cautious because the rand is very volatile...and the aluminium price is very important to us now, that took a knock a month ago but now has recovered very strongly," he said in an interview.
Gencor said in a statement with half-year results that the commodity divisions should maintain their current levels of profitability in the second half.
The company said its results for the first half reflected substantial growth for the group. Gencor lifted attributable income before exceptional items by 74 percent to 1,018 billion rand.
Its earnings per share, before exceptional items, rose by 49 percent to 60.2 cents from 40.5 in the corresponding period in 1995.
